op-plan.shape: interface OpPlan { op: Operation; transport: Transport; http:{verb:HttpVerb;route:string}; mcp:{name:string}; cli:{path:string[]}; grpc:{package:string;service:string;method:string}; params?: ParamInfo[]; envelope: Array<{field:string;pluginId:string;httpHeader:string;mcpMetaKey:string;cliFlag:string;envVar:string}>; cliFlags: Map<string,{camelKey:string;kind:'domain'|'envelope';valueKind:'boolean'|'json'|'string';envVar?:string}>; streaming:boolean; isMount:boolean; mountHandler?:(call:Call)=>Promise<LayerResult> }  // F3: `transport` is stamped per-package so dispatchForPlan's mount branch tags core-client Call.transport correctly (never a hardcoded 'http'). F2: cliFlags carries envVar (cli-output FlagSpec, run.ts:53-59) so parseArgs's flag->env-var fallback (run.ts:300-306) is not silently regressed. computed once per op (proposal §3a).

transport-adapter.shape: interface TransportAdapter<Raw=unknown> { registerRoute(plan:OpPlan, dispatch:(call:Omit<Call,'operation'|'ctx'>)=>Promise<LayerResult>):void; readCall(raw:Raw, plan:OpPlan):Omit<Call,'operation'|'ctx'>|Promise<Omit<Call,'operation'|'ctx'>>; writeResult(raw:Raw, result:LayerResult, plan:OpPlan):void|Promise<void>; writeError(raw:Raw, err:unknown, plan:OpPlan):void|Promise<void> }  // F1: dispatch returns Promise<LayerResult> and writeResult takes the resolved LayerResult (invoke.ts:94-102,152-156) — invoke() ALWAYS returns a Promise; only the resolved value is the unknown|AsyncIterable union. Raw stays a generic escape hatch (SSE needs reply.hijack). read/write are genuinely transport-specific (proposal §3c).

create-package-invoker.shape: function createPackageInvoker(schemas: ComposedSchemas, usePlugins: UsePlugin[]): InvokeFn  // PROMOTED into apigen-engine-runtime: absorbs the byte-identical buildInvokerForPackage/readUsePlugins/readUseOptions/adaptCoreLayer block (~120 lines, proposal §4) that fastify+express duplicate today, and those symbols are DELETED from the plugin files. Returns the existing InvokeFn; built once per package, not per request.

dispatch-for-plan.shape: function dispatchForPlan(plan: OpPlan, invoke: InvokeFn, call: Omit<Call,'operation'|'ctx'>, opts: InvokeOptions): Promise<LayerResult>  // F1: returns Promise<LayerResult> (invoke.ts:152-156) — NOT the bare `Promise<unknown> | AsyncIterable<unknown>` sketch, which does not type-check. Branches isMount?mountHandler(call):dispatch(fns,...) (mount now flows through the composed invoker per [fix:mount-through-layers]) and streaming-vs-scalar via isApiStream. F3: the mount branch adapts runtime Call (domainArgs/ctx:LayerContext) -> core-client Call (data/ctx:Extensions/transport/raw) and stamps Call.transport from plan.transport, never a hardcoded 'http'.
